TASK_GAP:
- Requirement: Add `unknown_duration_count` to per-repository and per-workflow-family aggregates so callers can tell a 0s run with a missing log archive from a genuine 0s run, in every code path `prepare_analysis_context` accepts.
  Expected change site: scripts/analyze_workflow_logs.py:391-408 (the else-branch loops that merge `_aggregate_runs_by_key` results into `per_repo`/`per_workflow_family`).
  Evidence of absence: When `load_input_data` is fed summary-stats-only input, `runs` ends up empty, so `computed_per_repo`/`computed_per_family` are empty and the loops never iterate. Entries copied verbatim from `summary_stats` at scripts/analyze_workflow_logs.py:378-389 never get `unknown_duration_count`. A consumer doing `per_repo["x"]["unknown_duration_count"]` would raise `KeyError`. The new test `test_prepare_analysis_context_percentiles_unchanged_and_unknown_count_surfaced` only exercises the path where `run_metrics` has at least one row.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
